text:
Egwuregwu 2026 World Cup nke San Francisco Bay Area na-eme na Santa Clara, obodo dị na nsọtụ ndịda nke Silicon Valley ihe dị ka maịl 40 n'ebe ndịda nke etiti San Francisco. Santa Clara malitere na 1777, mgbe e guzobere Mission Santa Clara de Asís; e webatara ya dị ka obodo na 1852. Metro San Francisco buru ibu na-aga n'ihu n'ihu, ruo presidio na mission Spanish nke 1776, tupu ọ gbasaa na Gold Rush nke 1849.

Taa Santa Clara bụ isi ụlọ ọrụ tech, na Levi's Stadium na-akwado ọnọdụ Bay Area dị ka mpaghara nnabata 2026. Aha nnabata FIFA "San Francisco Bay Area" gbasara kpọmkwem, na-agụnye Santa Clara na San Jose yana mpaghara Bay dum karịa otu obodo.

Ebe ọ bụ na ebe ahụ dị n'obodo nta, njirimara bọọlụ nke mpaghara ahụ ka mma nghọta site na metro dum. San Francisco Bay Area bụ otu n'ime akụkụ United States na-etinye aka na soccer. San Jose Earthquakes, ndị meriri MLS Cup ugboro abụọ, na-egwuri egwu nso na PayPal Park, na mpaghara ahụ na-adọta nnukwu, ndị na-akwado dị iche iche — gụnyere nkwado Mexican-American siri ike maka enyi enyi El Tri na maka egwuregwu Copa América na Gold Cup. Ịnụ ọkụ ahụ dabara na ndekọ nke ịhazi asọmpi mba ụwa ndị bụ isi, n'etiti ha Copa América Centenario na 2016 na CONCACAF Gold Cup na 2017.

Ịnụ ọkụ Bay Area maka egwuregwu ahụ dị n'ime omenala egwuregwu izugbe dị omimi na-adịghị ahụkebe. N'ofe mpaghara ahụ, nkwado na-agba ọsọ site na 49ers, Giants, Warriors na A's, na-enye ebe World Cup nke Santa Clara ndị na-ege ntị nke obodo ogologo oge na-asọ mpi ọkwa dị elu. Ọ bụ nchikọta ahụ — ntọala Silicon Valley, akara nnabata obodo dị iche iche, na otu n'ime ndị na-eso bọọlụ kacha kwado na mba ahụ — nke na-akọwa San Francisco Bay Area dị ka onye nnabata 2026.
